name: QOS♠Wife3~Kuro ni Somaru Hitozuma~
source:
After years of working hard at the company, one day you suddenly received a promotion. As you, busy with work, begin to notice that your wife is hiding something, your boss becomes kinder to you, and even that cold foreign secretary starts getting closer. What on earth could this be…

[From F95Zone]
